serviceArea: England and Wales, with most clients in South Yorkshire
audience: Employees facing dismissal, discrimination or a settlement agreement, who have never instructed a solicitor before

services.name: Unfair and constructive dismissal
services.description: Advice on whether a dismissal was lawful, and representation at employment tribunal where a claim is brought.

services.name: Discrimination and harassment claims
services.description: Claims under the Equality Act 2010 covering all nine protected characteristics, from grievance stage to tribunal.

services.name: Settlement agreements
services.description: Review and negotiation of settlement agreements, including the independent advice the agreement requires.

services.name: Grievances and disciplinary hearings
services.description: Preparing written grievances and briefing employees before internal hearings.

differentiators: We act for employees only, never for employers
Discrimination and dismissal claims are taken on a no win, no fee basis where the case meets our criteria
The solicitor who assesses your case is the one who runs it
Regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority, number 624183

contact.address: Second Floor, 34 Campo Lane, Sheffield S1 2EG

tone: Precise and steady. Explains the law without condescension, and never promises an outcome.
goals: Get employees to make contact early, before a tribunal deadline passes
Explain the three-month-less-one-day time limit clearly enough that people act on it
Set out how no win, no fee works so the first call is better informed
